authority: FFL scoring restored following the Nov 5, 2026 league constitutional challenge. Commissioner clarification confirms fourth-down stop and non-TD 40+ rush bonus remain 0; 40+ receiving and rushing TD bonuses restored to +1.5. No runtime Sleeper projection/scoring values.
limitations: Exact score requires every relevant NFL event; data absence never implies zero
Long-distance touchdown bonus stacking must be crosschecked from the league's documented rules
D/ST special-teams and scoring correction rules must be independently adjudicated

scoring_semantics.pass_long_completion: A verified completion >=40 yards earns +1 per qualifying completion, separate from 40+/50+ pass-TD bonuses.
scoring_semantics.field_goal_stacking: FG made = +3 base for each made field goal PLUS the matching distance tier (+0.5,+1,+2,+3,+4,+5). Do not replace base with tier. Only use verified counts; percentages cannot stand in for attempts or makes.
scoring_semantics.receptions: Distance reception bonus +0.5 for 30-39 yard catches and +1 for 40+ yard catches, in addition to standard half-PPR.
scoring_semantics.long_touchdowns: Record 40+ and 50+ touchdown bonuses independently only when source evidence establishes each; a 50+ TD also qualifies for a 40+ threshold if Sleeper applies both configured bonuses.
scoring_semantics.missing_evidence: Never treat unknown per-category values as zero; team scores and kicker projections are marked partial where required categories are missing.
scoring_semantics.three_and_out: D/ST earns +0.5 per verified opponent three-and-out, separate from other defensive scoring. Source must count the full drive; not inferred from punts alone.
scoring_semantics.fourth_down_stop: Zero FFL points for a fourth-down stop, independently confirmed by the Commissioner.
scoring_semantics.long_non_touchdown_rush: No separate 40+ rushing-play bonus without a touchdown; ordinary rushing yards still score. A verified 40+ rushing TD separately earns its restored +1.5 long-TD bonus.
scoring_semantics.two_point_return: D/ST earns +2 per verified defensive 2-point conversion return.
